grader.scenario: Mobile voicemail greeting stuck on robot voice; 6 faults (poor)
grader.notes: Poor call marked by failed branding, dead air breaches, failed verification, failed personalization, rude remarks, and unresolved voicemail greeting, alongside handled empathy.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent failed standard opening branding ('Voicemail support desk...') and closing branding.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Agent allowed two separate unmanaged dead air gaps of 40 seconds at turns 14 and 34.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Agent failed to ask for full postal address or security PIN during verification.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent never addressed customer as Reuben anywhere in the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated empathy at turn 22 ('I understand how intensely furious and devastating it is to lose eight thousand pounds in client contracts this morning...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent accurately paraphrased the corrupted voicemail greeting issue.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent asked for mobile number at turn 42 despite customer stating 07700 900882 at turn 3.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent provided ##002# forwarding disable workaround, logged database ticket, and applied goodwill credit.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent insulted customer at turn 11: 'If you run an independent commercial trade business, you should be subscribing to our business mobile plan rather than using a standard consumer retail SIM card.'

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent gathered details on 1571 greeting setup and symptoms.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Voicemail greeting remained corrupted with customer advised to re-record after overnight batch processing.
